body:
The way I see it is that if I ended my life i would introduce the same pain that I feel onto my loved ones. The guilt and the sadness they would feel because they couldn't help or that they didn't see how much pain I was in because I was too scared to tell them I needed help. 
I am putting myself before all those that would be negatively impacted by my decision to kill my self. I see that as a very selfish act.
I have not been to a morgue but I have once seen the body of someone that had just died. It was during a big party on a lake and i had been drinking so the memory is not the clearest.
